body.statement:
For \(D\in\mathcal D_{\mathrm{SN},3}\), write \(D=\delta^eE\) with \(e\) maximal.  Tamano's three-dimensional determinant-stripping and spectral reduction classifies the constant, rank-one, and pure-plane residue branches as flag powers.  In the remaining mixed branch, \(E\) is nonzero on \(C3\), and there are integers \(a,b\geq1\) such that
\[
 \operatorname{spec}\!\left(\frac{G_E(X)X}{E(X)}\right)=\{a+b,b,0\}
 \qquad(X\in C3).
\]
In this mixed branch, constancy of the one-dimensional kernel of \(G_E(X)\) reduces the residue to the two-dimensional converse and is the only unresolved step in that reduction.
